abilitygroupinfo.slug: Do not call upon that which you cannot put down.

abilitygroupdescription.p: Conjuration is the most versatile, powerful and therefore hardest to control and most dangerous of all magical schools. It involves harnessing raw magical powers by the caster directly.

abilitydescription.p: This ability represents the characters knowledge of conjuration magic and its theory.

action.name: Cast
action.righteoussuccess: May make an additional chain lightning attack as a free action.

abilitydescription.p: The caster acts as a conduit for eldritch energies, directing them in an arc at a target. First the caster checks magic to gather the energy. Then they roll to a 2d12+Rank against the targets defence. If the arc successfuls hits, the caster can arc the lightning to a subsequent target making another to hit roll, and so on until the caster misses or runs out of potential targets. The initial target can be any opponent within range . When choosing subsequent targets the caster must choose the closest untargeted enemy to the last target. No target can be struck more than once.
On overcharge the caster is also struck.

action.name: Magic-Attack
action.grimfail: Caster is knocked back and is Prone and takes d3 damage
action.effect: Target takes damage and is Pushed DC: 15+Rank

abilitydescription.p: The caster shoots a raw stream of thaumic energy from their hands at one or more targets. If the stream hits the target, the target suffers damage and is thrown away from the caster. For Large creatures the distance thrown is reduced at the GMs discretion.

action.name: Magic-Attack
action.effect: Target takes damage and is Pushed or Pulled DC: 15+Rank

abilitydescription.p: The caster uses a raw stream of thaumic energy to grab a target crushing it and pulling it towards him. If successful the caster makes a second attack against the targets Dodge, Agility, or Strength Defence Check, with a +6+Rank bonus.
If they hit the target, the target suffers damage and is either pushed or pulled in any direction.
The character can view events from the past using an item as a thaumic anchor. (Viewing events in the future is incredibly difficult and unreliable. See Scry, Greater).

The caster first checknames a target, holding items with contagious links to the target, then checks to see whether the spell succeeds. If it does, they see an important scene from targets life (the GM narrates the scene to the player). The caster may then choose to scry for one or more important past events associated with those items.

Contagion is very important for this spell to work. A good contagious link to the subject, the targets blood, or hair, can reduce the difficulty of this spell by multiple shifts. Subsequent contagious items have reduced effectiveness.

The character can view events from a targets present and their future as well as their past. This spell works like the lesser Scry but because the future is not predetermined the results are often very unreliable and inaccurate.

action.name: Magic-Attack
action.any-success: Deal 5+Rank Damage. The caster heals half the damage dealt.

abilitydescription.p: The caster rolls to grab an opponent. On success the caster acts as a conduit to one of the dread planes, life is drained from the target. Anything that increases contagion will increase damage for this spell.
